name: Pinball Arcade: Black Rose
storyline: Black Rose (1992) was designed by John Trudeau and Brian Eddy, who also worked together on the Williams classic, The Machine: Bride of Pin-Bot. This table gives you landlubbers the chance to live the life of a pirate on the high seas! Enter the Pirates Cove for Multi-Ball and a chance to find hidden treasure, spiral your way to an extra ball on the Whirlpool ramp and collect torches, gun powder and cannon balls to open Davey Jones Locker. Sink ships with the deadly accurate cannon that pops up from the playfield and fires pinballs. Three interactive video modes test your pirating skills to prove you're no scallywag. This game is loaded! 3,746 units of this classic table were produced.
